record.description_evidence:
"AIFastPPT" is an innovative app designed to provide users with a fast and efficient presentation creation experience using AI technology. Whether you are a student, teacher, professional, or entrepreneur needing to deliver a professional presentation, "AIFastPPT" offers the perfect solution.

Feature Overview:

1. AI One-Click Presentation Generation: "AIFastPPT" uses advanced AI technology to enable one-click presentation generation. Users simply input a topic or keywords, and the AI automatically generates a slide deck with rich content and a logical structure.

2. Multiple Generation Methods:
   - Topic Generation: Enter a topic, and the AI will provide a presentation with relevant content.
   - File Upload Generation: Supports document uploads to automatically extract key content and generate a presentation.
   - Long Text Paste Generation: Directly paste text, and the AI will intelligently analyze and generate a presentation.
   - URL Link Paste Generation: Enter a URL, and the AI will extract webpage content to generate a presentation.

3. Extensive Template Library: "AIFastPPT" includes hundreds of high-quality templates covering business, education, technology, art, and more. Each template is carefully designed to ensure your presentation is visually appealing.

User Experience:

1. Simple and Intuitive Interface: "AIFastPPT" features a clear and straightforward user interface, allowing users to get started easily without a complex learning process. All functions are optimized for a smooth user experience.

2. High Customization: Users can personalize the generated presentations according to their needs, including changing colors, fonts, layouts, etc., to ensure every slide deck matches their style and requirements.

Technical Advantages:

1. Powerful AI Algorithms: "AIFastPPT" relies on advanced AI technology to quickly analyze and generate high-quality presentation content. Our algorithms continuously learn and improve to provide increasingly accurate content generation.

2. Data Security Assurance: We prioritize user privacy and data security. "AIFastPPT" employs multi-layered security measures to ensure that uploaded files and generated presentation content are fully protected.

Application Scenarios:

1. Education: Teachers can quickly generate teaching materials, and students can easily create presentation reports, enhancing learning and teaching efficiency.

2. Business: Professionals can use "AIFastPPT" to quickly create project reports, business plans, etc., improving work efficiency and professionalism.

3. Creative Displays: Designers and artists can use the extensive templates and customization features to easily create outstanding creative presentation slide decks.

To cancel, turn off 24 hours before the end of each cycle. No charge will be made within the 24 hours prior.

Slide Forge turns a topic, a web link or a document into a finished, designed presentation in about a minute. Kai, your presentation assistant, plans the story, writes every slide and finds the right photos.

A REAL STORY, NOT A PILE OF SLIDES
• Kai plans the whole deck first, then writes each slide for its place in the story.
• 12 designer themes and 10 smart layouts: covers, key points, columns, big numbers, quotes, full-screen photos and more.
• Start from anything: type a topic, paste a link, or upload a PDF, Word or PowerPoint file. Your facts stay your facts.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Tap any text to edit it, right on the slide.
• Switch the layout or the whole theme with one tap. Everything stays perfectly laid out.
• AI rewrite: change the tone of the whole deck, use simpler words, make it shorter, or translate it.
• Free stock photos, speaker notes, undo and redo.

IMPORT AND RESTYLE
Bring an existing deck from PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides, Canva or PDF. Slide Forge keeps your slides, order, facts and photos, and rebuilds every slide in a clean new design.

PRESENT LIVE
Share a link and your audience follows your slides on their own phones and laptops as you present. They can react, ask questions and vote in polls. Your iPhone becomes the remote.

SHARE AND KNOW
Export to PowerPoint (.pptx) or PDF, or share a web link anyone can open without an app. Link stats show views, time on each slide and how far people got.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
A full canvas with floating tools on iPad, light and dark mode, iCloud sync between your devices, and 14 languages.

SLIDE FORGE VIP
Your first deck is free. VIP unlocks unlimited decks, editing and AI rewrite, PowerPoint export, live presenting, link stats and exports without the Slide Forge line.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

record.name: ChatZima
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ZIMA is the all-in-one AI chat app: Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini in one place, plus AI images, video, music, voice chat, and a Gallery of everything you create. Chat with Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 from Anthropic, GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna from OpenAI, and Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro — 32 models, one subscription, one clean, fast interface.

One App. Every Model.
Stop juggling AI subscriptions. Pick the right model for each task — quick answers, deep research, writing, coding — switch mid-conversation without losing context, and turn on extended thinking for the hardest problems. Start free, no account needed, with Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and more. Upgrade to Lite, Pro or Max for every premium model and higher daily limits.

AI Image Generation
Create images in any chat just by asking. Choose your image model in Image Options: OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5, Google's Nano Banana 2, ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Lite and Pro, or Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 Max. Ask for up to 4 variations and each appears the moment it's ready. Tap an image's tag, like A2, and say what to change ("make A2 warmer"), or pick a one-tap adjustment. New image models arrive without an app update.

AI Video Generation
Make short videos with sound in any chat. Gemini Omni Flash is the default, or choose ByteDance's Seedance, MiniMax H3, or Google's Veo 3.1 in Video Options. Ask for up to 4 versions at once, bring a photo to life, then edit or extend any clip just by asking: "make it nighttime," "keep going." Clips play right in the chat.

Music, Sound Effects & Speech
Ask for a song with lyrics or an instrumental, a sound effect or looping ambience, or text read aloud in one of ten natural voices — even as a dialogue. Powered by ElevenLabs, every track plays right in the chat.

Your Gallery
Every image, video, and track you've made, across all your chats, in one place. Browse by date or by chat, filter by type or model, and search your prompts. Jump back to the chat where something was made, or use it as the reference for a new chat. Save, share, or delete.

Voice Chat & Dictation
Hold the mic and choose Voice chat for a real spoken conversation with ChatGPT or Gemini, and switch mid-call. Show it a photo or document, share your camera with Gemini, and get answers from the live web — every call is transcribed into your chat. Or tap the mic to dictate: your words fill the message box as you speak.

Know When It's Ready
Turn on notifications and ZIMA tells you the moment a video, song, or image set is done — or when a reply finishes after you've left.

Web Search & Link Reading
Answers grounded in the live web, with sources you can tap. Paste a link and ask about it, or have ZIMA pull real photos from the web into the chat.

Gmail & Google Drive
Connect your Google account and ZIMA can search your email and files — "what did Sarah say about the launch date?" It drafts emails for you to send yourself (ZIMA never sends) and creates Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Forms in your Drive. Every read shows a card in chat, so you always know what was accessed.

Real Files, Created in Chat
Ask for a report, spreadsheet, or deck and get a downloadable Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, or CSV file right in the conversation. Preview, download, or save to Drive, then refine by asking.

Upload & Ask
Attach images, PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, and more. ZIMA reads them, answers your questions, and remembers earlier attachments even in long conversations.

Always Organized
Every chat is saved, searchable, and synced between iOS and the web. Edit or delete your messages anytime.

Clear Privacy
Your messages go to the provider of the model you pick, solely to generate your reply — never to train AI models. A plain-language "AI & Your Data" page shows exactly what ZIMA shares with AI providers, before first use and anytime in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://chatzima.com/terms-of-service

record.description_evidence:
The operating system for hiring. TALNT scores and screens every applicant the moment they apply — then helps your team source, schedule, check, and hire across every location.

TALNT is the AI-native recruiting platform built for the businesses that run on people: multi-location healthcare systems, logistics fleets, automotive and collision MSOs, restaurant groups, skilled trades (HVAC, electrical, plumbing), manufacturing operators, retail chains, construction firms, and hospitality groups. One workspace. Every team. Every industry.

Run your whole pipeline from one screen: capture an applicant, auto-score them against the role, screen with AI, send a prescreen, self-schedule the interview, order background checks, capture a scorecard, and move to offer. Every step is logged on the candidate timeline, every outreach respects TCPA + CAN-SPAM consent, and every score is explainable.

— AI screening at apply: every applicant is auto-scored against the role the moment they apply, with a recommendation (advance / review / hold / decline), knockout flags, and tailored phone-screen questions waiting for your recruiter.

— Apply by chat, QR, or text: a trade-aware conversational assistant screens applicants in plain language; printable QR codes and "text me the link" turn any flyer or counter into an application — built for hourly and deskless hiring.

— Bilingual applications: the full candidate flow — careers page, chat, scheduling, and prescreen — works in English and Spanish.

— Candidate self-scheduling: send a calendar-synced booking link by email or SMS; candidates pick a time and the pipeline advances automatically.

— Checks & credentials: track background checks, MVR, drug screens, WOTC, licenses, and certifications as first-class records. Connect Checkr to order and sync results — and a candidate can't be marked hired until required checks clear.

— AI resume parsing: drop in a PDF or DOCX and TALNT extracts title, employer, certifications, skills, and history. Review before saving — nothing overwrites without your confirmation.

— AI match scoring: role-aware fit on experience, certifications, location radius, comp, availability, and industry. Deterministic scores stay the system of record; an AI layer adds strengths, concerns, and interview probes.

— AI interview questions & scorecard summary: tailored question packs by role and candidate, plus a one-brief synthesis of every panelist's scorecard with recommendation, signal, and next step.

— Location benchmarks: compare every rooftop on open roles, pipeline, hires, time-to-fill, and stale candidates — with automatic callouts for the sites that need attention.

— Talent rediscovery: surface past applicants and dormant leads who still match your open roles, and re-engage them in one tap.

— Prescreen workflow: send a candidate-facing form by email, SMS, or link; statuses move Not sent → Sent → Opened → Completed automatically.

— Communication history: every email, SMS, call, and note in one timeline. Reply detection pauses outreach automatically.

— Outbound webhooks: HMAC-signed candidate, interview, and prescreen events to your endpoint, with retries.

— Integration honesty: TALNT handles candidate management, importing, tracking, and outreach end-to-end. External job-board + ATS integrations (Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) are available on request and require partner approval — we never imply live access unless it's actually wired.

Built for recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and admins, with role-based access control over who sees what.

Web app at https://www.gettalnt.com — the iOS app gives you the same workflows on the road.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Recruiting does not wait until you are back at your computer. A candidate calls, a hiring manager needs an answer, and the details are sitting in a system you cannot reach.

Crelate, the AI Recruiting Platform, puts your records on your phone. Look someone up between meetings, log the call while it is fresh, and see where a role stands before you walk in.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Search every contact, company and job in your Crelate account
• Open a contact and see their history, their resume, and the jobs they are active for
• Log a call, a note or a meeting the moment it happens
• Call, text or email straight from the record
• Fix a phone number or an email address on the spot
• Work your calendar: complete, update or reschedule what is booked
• Filter by the custom lists and views your team already uses

Everything you record syncs to your Crelate account immediately, so the rest of your team sees it without anyone writing the same note twice.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Crelate account. Text messaging requires an active text messaging license.

ABOUT CRELATE
Crelate is the AI Recruiting Platform that turns the relationships and data you already own into your next hire. Applicant tracking, recruiting CRM and sourcing sit in one open platform, built for how recruiters work and open to the rest of your stack. More than 25,000 recruiting professionals have used Crelate since 2012.
